title: Processing human skin samples for single-cell assays
protocol: Obtain skin punch biopsies under local anesthesia.
Place collected tissue samples in a 15 mL Falcon tube containing 2 mL of RPMI 1640, kept on ice.
Transfer the tube immediately to the laboratory for further processing.
Dissect biopsy into smaller pieces under sterile conditions at 20°C–24°C.
Prepare digestion mix in a gentleMACS C tube according to instructions from Miltenyi Whole Skin Dissociation Kit.
Thaw one aliquot of each Enzyme (P, A, D).
Transfer 435 μL of Buffer L into the gentleMACS C tube.
Add 12.5 μL of Enzyme P and resuspend carefully.
Add 50 μL of Enzyme D and resuspend carefully.
Add 2.5 μL of Enzyme A and resuspend carefully.
Rinse tissue with PBS to remove remaining blood.
Remove skin biopsy from the tube and place it on a 60 mm petri dish.
Add 1–2 mL of sterile PBS to the petri dish containing the biopsy.
Gently shake the petri dish, then aspirate the PBS.
Repeat shaking and aspiration 2–3 times if necessary until clear.
Completely aspirate PBS and discard.
Dissect the skin biopsy: remove subcutaneous fat from the biopsy by carefully scraping it using a curved cutting-edge scalpel.
Fixate the biopsy with forceps and gently cut it with a curved scalpel to obtain pieces of 1 mm² dimension.
Wet the scalpel with digestion mix in between dissections to prevent drying of tissue pieces.
Maintain all dissected tissue pieces moist throughout the procedure.
Scrape the dissected tissue pieces off the petri dish using a scalpel.
Transfer the dissected tissue into a gentleMACS C tube containing the prepared digestion mix.
Tightly close the lid of the gentleMACS C tube.
Transfer the gentleMACS C tube with minced biopsy to a pre-heated water bath at 37°C and shaker set at 220 RPM.
Incubate the mixture in the water bath for 3 hours.
Take out the gentleMACS C tube from the water bath.
Add 500 μL of cold tissue culture media to the tube containing the digestion mix with the biopsy.
Close the lid tightly beyond the first resistance.
Perform the mechanical digestion in the gentle MACS dissociator.
Place the tube upside down into the slot of the dissociator and check that the tube is correctly attached.
Select the program h_skin_01 and run it one time.
Carefully detach the gentleMACS C tube from the dissociator.
Spin down the tissue for 1–2 min at 300 g in a pre-cooled centrifuge.
Place the gentleMACS C tube on ice to prevent further digestion.
Prepare a sterile 70 μM cell strainer over a fresh 50 mL Falcon tube.
Take the gentleMACS C tube from the centrifuge.
Briefly vortex the content for 5 seconds to loosen any remaining tissue.
Transfer the content of the gentleMACS C tube to the prepared cell strainer by quickly pouring the tube and tapping the tube over the cell strainer to transfer remaining tissue pieces.
Transfer 10 mL of ice-cold wash buffer (PBS with 10% FCS) into the empty gentleMACS C tube to collect remaining cells.
Rinse the cell strainer ten times with 1 mL of PBS 10% FCS wash buffer from the gentleMACS C tube.
Apply rotatory movements to the strainer and the tube in order to make sure to wash the strainer thoroughly, including edges.
After all liquid has passed through, discard the cell strainer and close the Falcon tube.
Aspirate the supernatant with a suction pump.
Be cautious to aspirate only on the side of the tube.
Leave 10–20 μL of buffer in the tube.
Dislodge the pellet and resuspend cells in 50 μL of FACS-Sort Buffer.
Add 1 μL of Fc-Block to the 50 μL cell suspension.
Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at 20°C–24°C.
Add 50 μL of the antibody mix prepared in FACS buffer to the cells.
Resuspend cells directly in 100 μL of FACS staining buffer.
Add 2 μL of Fc-Block to the resuspended cells.
Incubate the mixture for 5 min or extend to 15 min if using CITE-seq antibodies.
Vortex the cells after adding each antibody separately.
Transfer the whole content into a new FACS-Sort tube.
Stain the cells at 4°C in the dark for 30 min.
Add 1 mL of FACS buffer to the stained cells.
Centrifuge the mixture at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend in 200 μL of FACS buffer.
Keep the tube on wet ice until sorting.
Optionally, hashtag skin or PBMCs cells simultaneously with antibody staining using Total-Seq Antibody.
Use 2 μL of Total-Seq Antibody per 100 μL of skin single-cell suspension.
If blood from the same donor is processed, isolate PBMCs on a Ficoll gradient.
Stain 1 million PBMCs for CD45+ with a different hashtag.
Incubate stained PBMCs for 30 min at 4°C in the dark simultaneously to skin cells.
For blood samples, use 1 μL of a different Total-Seq antibody in 100 μL of FACS-Sort buffer.
Exclude non-viable PBMCs with 7-AAD as for skin cells before sorting.
Add 2 μL of 7-AAD dye directly to the cell suspension.
Vortex the tube briefly for 5 seconds.
Sort a total of 30,000 cells using the FACSAria III cytometer.
Sort 15,000 CD45+ skin cells and 15,000 CD45+ PBMCs.
Set the speed of sorting to as low as possible.
Acquire 1000 cells and plot them on a forward scatter (FSC) versus side scatter (SSC) plot.
Set the gate on all lymphocytes.
Exclude doublets with FSC-height vs FSC-width gating.
Optional: Exclude doublets further using SSC-height vs SSC-area gating.
Plot the cells for viability using the 7-AAD marker.
Gate on viable cells which are 7-AAD negative.
Set a sorting gate for CD45+ cells.
Set a second sorting gate for CD45- cells.
Increase sorting speed to approximately 1000 cells/s.
Collect sorted cells directly into PCR-tubes containing 20 μL sterile PBS with 0.08% BSA.
Spin down the collected cells.
Resuspend cells at a concentration between 700 to 1200 cells/μL.
Store resuspended cells at 4°C until use.
Run the cells through the Chromium chip as soon as possible to ensure cell viability.
Optional: Use the volume reduction device VR-NxT (Silicon Biosystems) after FACS-purification.
Centrifuge cells sorted into PCR tubes for 10 min at 500 g in a centrifuge with swing out rotor.
Transfer the tube into the VR-Nxt adaptor and close with the cap following manufacturer’s instructions.
Perform volume reduction using the high-volume setup to obtain a final total volume of 15 μL supernatant.
